We're streaming live at 4pm GMT!

Come see the dev play Rocket Panda Panic and ask any burning questions you might have!

notes.title: The Pandy, Pad and the Pandaemic Patch.
notes.notes:
A quick update based on some feedback from streamers and curators.  Many thanks to those who tested and played.  Your reports on game bugs + ideas for improvement are really very helpful!

Rapid Fire
No longer must you bash buttons like some clicker app. Press and hold the fire button (pad or keyboard) and the weapon will shoot bullets for dayssss.

Hover Mode
The same as rapid fire.  After jumping once, a second press and hold will fire Pandys Jetpack at regular intervals.  You'll still need to be conscious of your falling/climbing momentum, but hovering or moving from side to side is much easier now. 

Controller Support
The game now fully works with pad. Tested with my Xbox360 controller (confirmation of Xbox1 and PS pads to come).  Only one part still needs pad support - the options screen.  However you can enter and exit the options using pad.

Misc
A few small alterations, such as Pandra's voice having the volume increased a little. 

Thanks again to those who played and gave feedback.  Keep it coming and I'll keep improving things!

P.S - Achievements incoming.  We're aiming for release on 8 October 2020.

notes.title: Blast off Feedback Update
notes.notes:
We'd like to start by thanking everyone who's playing Rocket Panda Panic! It's been a wild ride getting to publication. We've heard some great early feedback that we wanted to act upon immediately. After a coffee fueled all nighter, we're proud to bring you a few tidied bugs and some extra features to boot! 

Auto Save.
Once you finish a level the progress is now stored. The menu "Start" button will take you to a level select screen.

Greater Maneuverability.
Pandy has been doing his squats; increasing run speed, jump height and flight acceleration.

Re-balanced Enemies.
Tanks fire a little slower, flyers spawn a little less frequently, health kits drop a little more often. You're welcome (Glea - "[i]weak[/i]!"). However, I will be keeping the original crazy hard settings stored ready to add a difficulty option later. 

Helicopter Warning.
Some may have tried to fight the Helicopter. It's invincible!!! Sorry if you didn't spot the text, it's a little tricky I'll admit. We've added a UI prompt to remind/telegraph the need to escape. I'm interested to hear any suggestions for improvement to telegraphing this to new players.

Tutorial Update.
Parallax scrolling added to the tutorial and a couple of the signs reworked to better prompt the keyboard controls/mechanics.

Custom Mouse.
This worked only for some in version 1.0. The custom paw mouse cursor is now available for all!
Also mouse "click in to hide" requirement resolved. Game is correctly focused now.

Disk Space Optimization.
Bizarrely, this 226 Mb download originally unpacked to a hefty 4.5 Gig. A little searching led me to some compression settings in Unreal Engine. Now correctly setup, the game downloads for 226 Mb and unpacks to 354 Mb.

Thanks again for playing Rocket Panda Panic. Stay safe everyone! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Panic is our greatest enemy.
notes.notes:
It's finally that time. GuMa Games have collectively sunk into our comfy chairs having completed Rocket Panda Panic's game content. It's been a busy 10 months but we've loved every second of it. Seeing an idea we had in November 2019 appearing on Steam in August 2020 is an incredible feeling.

It's amazing to look over our current work and compare it to the GameJam where this all started.  Back in February, before lockdown, (ah simpler times) an excited Matt arrived at Glyndwr University, ready to start a 3 day development marathon. We'd had the idea a few months earlier, but no opportunity to prototype the mechanics. After several months of discussing the idea, it was really exciting to finally get it into the Unreal Engine. As Matt setup at Glyndwr UK, Glea was setting up her own workspace in Davao Philippines. Soon we were given the theme - reconstruction.  This inspired the Lincoln Memorial objective seen in level 1. It wouldn't be until a few months later, that torn down statues became so satirical.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38503022/9fb1a9b1f70d5c3a3a44e6d714faccbe0888df6e.png[/img]
The Global Game Jam event has inspired 1000's of developers to set out on new exciting projects. It's not just for coders either. Anyone with an interest in gaming can join the fray and help in one way or another.  If you've never attended one, we strongly recommend giving it a go. You'll love the creative energy in the room and it's a great way to build experience. https://globalgamejam.org/ 

Soon after the GameJam, the plan was to setup the GuMa Games offices in Davao City Philippines. However, a certain virus had other plans! Suddenly trapped apart, we worried whether our game was even possible. Luckily our experiences during the GameJam had helped us to setup remote working practices. We continued throughout summer to focus on this way of working. We're pleased to say we're only a few days off the original schedule of release.

Today we submitted Rocket Panda Panic to Steamworks so Valve can run their checks on the game. We've no doubt it'll all be approved. That means you'll be playing Rocket Panda Panic on 7 September 2020. We can't wait to let you all give it a go. Add to your Steam Wishlist so you don't miss out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240180/Rocket_Panda_Panic/

notes.title: Nearly there...
notes.notes:
Hi fans of Pandas and Panic!

Me and Glea have been working on finishing Rocket Panda Panic as soon as possible.  At present, the content is all complete!  We have some bugs to fix and a few secondary features to update, but it's nearly there!

We'll be doing some testing of the finished game in private sessions over the next week.  If there's anyone interested in being a tester, you can contact us at www.GumaGames.com/contact.

We also released a story trailer to give people a clearer idea of whats going on in this crazy game! Here's a link...

[previewyoutube=-mAv57YBn_Y;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


We hope you're all surviving the stress of Covid. We had our wedding cancelled as a result of this lockdown. That's why we made this game.  To vent our frustration and stress.  Keep safe, wear those masks. And if you still need to de-stress, get Rocket Panda Panic on Steam!
